name: zombie-survival
description: Zombie FPS Open World - Mobile Web Multiplayer Game

scripts.docker:sim:split:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.db.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.app.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:sim:split:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.app.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env down && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.db.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env down
scripts.docker:sim:edge:up: npm run docker:sim:edge:sync && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.edge.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d
scripts.docker:sim:up: npm run docker:sim:edge:up && npm run docker:sim:init-data && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:sim:up:debug: npm run docker:sim:edge:up && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.debug.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:sim:restart: npm run docker:sim:edge:up && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:sim:down:all: npm run docker:sim:down && npm run docker:sim:edge:down
scripts.docker:sim:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env exec game node tools/migrate-game-accounts-to-auth.mjs --apply
scripts.docker:sim:import-sqlite: docker cp database/local-dev.sqlite zs-vm-game-1:/tmp/game.sqlite && docker cp database/auth-local.sqlite zs-vm-game-1:/tmp/auth.sqlite && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env exec -e SQLITE_GAME_PATH=/tmp/game.sqlite -e SQLITE_AUTH_PATH=/tmp/auth.sqlite game node tools/import-sqlite-accounts-to-mysql.mjs --apply
